claim_boundary: This protocol validates public experimental plume movies and derives auditable bilateral sensory histories. It does not grant controller access, modify sealed v1/v2 results, identify a MaleCNS odor-motion circuit, or evaluate navigation performance.

upstream.publication_code_role: author-maintained publication/reproduction code used as provenance authority for public input contracts and published cue definitions

temporal_profiles.rule: Corrected 60 Hz interpolation may reproduce the published processing timeline but does not create new measurements. Fly-sniff must not treat interpolated smooth frames as evidence for timing below the native 66.7 ms interval.

complex.native_fps_policy: Read and receipt the archive/NWB time basis. Do not silently assume a frame rate from the fly-sniff simulator or the upstream model history contract.
complex.known_gap: The public validation window can reproduce the temporal maps but does not include the published Figure 1 complex snapshot at full-video frame 2900. No substitute snapshot may be labeled as the published frame.

published_bilateral_history.note: This documents the upstream model-data contract. It does not imply that fly-sniff has the unavailable legacy train/test arrays or that every public raw movie is natively 60 Hz.

qualification_order: verify source bytes and archive identity
reproduce upstream plume gradient/motion statistics before defining fly-sniff sensory features
freeze physical coordinate and antenna-sampling transform
derive bilateral histories without source coordinates, centerline labels, or future samples
qualify timing/gradient features on smooth and complex plumes while respecting each source native time basis
only then consider a separately sealed functional connectome protocol
stop_rules: do not proceed if source identity, dimensions, time basis, or coordinate mapping is unresolved
do not choose smooth versus complex plume based on which helps navigation
do not tune a timing estimator on future navigation performance
do not treat temporal interpolation as new sensory measurements
do not infer sub-66.7-ms smooth-plume timing from the native 15 Hz Dryad movie
do not overwrite or reinterpret the v2 blocked_no_resolvable_plume_timing result
do not describe any substitute complex snapshot as the unavailable published frame 2900
